settings.label: GoTrue URL
settings.meaning: GoTrue's base URL as this server reaches it, path prefix included: https://<project>.supabase.co/auth/v1, or http://127.0.0.1:9999 for a sidecar. Its keys are at <url>/.well-known/jwks.json.
settings.whereToFind: Supabase: Project Settings › API › Project URL, plus /auth/v1. Self-hosted: the address GoTrue listens on (API_EXTERNAL_URL). Test is another project or instance, with its own URL and keys.

settings.label: JWKS URL
settings.meaning: Where the signing keys are, when it isn't <url>/.well-known/jwks.json (an internal address).

settings.label: Issuer
settings.meaning: The iss every token must carry. Default the URL. GoTrue sets iss only when its own GOTRUE_JWT_ISSUER is configured, so set both to the same value.
settings.whereToFind: GoTrue's GOTRUE_JWT_ISSUER; on Supabase, the project URL with /auth/v1.

settings.label: Audience
settings.meaning: The aud every token must carry. Default authenticated.

settings.label: Service key
settings.meaning: Reads a user's record through GoTrue's admin API, to say whether their email is verified (goTrueVerifiedEmail). Never sent to a browser.
settings.whereToFind: Supabase: Project Settings › API Keys › the secret (service_role) key. Self-hosted: a JWT signed with GoTrue's key whose role is service_role.

settings.label: Hook secret
settings.meaning: Checks that an HTTP hook came from GoTrue: v1,whsec_<base64>, several separated by | while one is being rotated.
settings.whereToFind: Supabase: Authentication › Hooks › the hook › Secret. Self-hosted: GOTRUE_HOOK_<NAME>_SECRETS.

operations.name: discovery.get
operations.purpose: Reads GoTrue's discovery document for its issuer. Only with discoverIssuer.

operations.name: jwks.get
operations.purpose: Reads GoTrue's signing keys: when none are cached, when the cache expires, and when a token names a key not yet seen (at most once per cooldown).

operations.name: settings.get
operations.purpose: Reads GoTrue's public settings, for whether it confirms sign-ups without sending mail (mailer_autoconfirm).

operations.name: users.get
operations.purpose: Reads one user's record through the admin API, for its email and email_confirmed_at.

signature.description: Standard Webhooks: webhook-id, webhook-timestamp (Unix seconds) and webhook-signature headers; the signature is v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256 of '<id>.<timestamp>.<raw body>'> keyed with the base64 after whsec_. Several signatures may be space-separated; one match is enough. Refuse a timestamp more than five minutes away.

events.meaning: The custom access token hook: GoTrue is issuing a token and waits for the claims to put in it.
GoTrue would send an auth email (confirmation, reset, magic link) and lets the app send it instead.
GoTrue would send an auth SMS and lets the app send it instead.
A user is about to be created; the answer can refuse it.
An MFA verification attempt; the answer can refuse it.
A password verification attempt; the answer can refuse it.
